Cold-water immersion and the brain

Two innovations

1First fMRI study

We tracked mood and brain connections in the same people before and after whole-body cold-water immersion.

Read the original study

2A validated protocol

We developed and published a step-by-step method that other labs can use.

Read the published protocol
  1. BeforeMood rating and brain scan
  2. 5 min at 20 °CHeart rate and breathing recorded
  3. AfterRepeat brain scan and mood rating
University of Portsmouth

Outdoor swimming and depression

From one patient to a national trial

  1. 2018
    1 patient

    Case report

    Weekly open-water swimming in a woman with major depression.

  2. 2022
    61 recruited

    Sea-swimming feasibility study

    One group took eight coached sessions. Depression scores stayed below baseline at three months.

  3. 2022–23
    87 randomised

    OUTSIDE feasibility trial

    Three sites. In the swim group, 79% attended at least four of eight sessions.

  4. 2024–26
    533 enrolled

    OUTSIDE 2 Full-scale randomised trial

    Tests swimming alongside usual care for depression and value for money. Follow-up at 38 weeks.

    Results in analysis

Co-design with patients

People with lived experience helped shape the trial and its participant information.

Barriers to taking part

Participants, coaches and social prescribers helped identify what made taking part harder.
